rthdApprovedProjectRegister.sourceTitle: Road Transport and Highways Division — Approved Projects
rthdApprovedProjectRegister.note: Nine records from the first page of the official list have been transcribed into this pilot register. The portal reports 73 approved-project entries in total; the remaining 64 entries have not been imported. This dataset is not a complete national project register.
rthdApprovedProjectRegister.pageCoverage: Rows 1–10 of the first page, excluding no project records; the mega-project Line-6 record is held separately from the 73-entry approved-project list.

rthdMegaProjectRegister.sourceTitle: Road Transport and Highways Division — Mega Projects
rthdMegaProjectRegister.note: The RTHD mega-project index shows a Line-6 report updated 12 October 2026. The metrics transcribed below are from the directly accessible February 2026 PDF; the October PDF is not yet extracted, so do not label those metrics current.

coverage.mapLocationPolicy: Map project points only when a project document gives a usable site coordinate or route geometry. Otherwise show an administrative-area highlight and label the location precision; never place a false point at a district centre.

projects.name: Dhaka Mass Rapid Transit Development Project (Line-6)
projects.modelNotice: Conceptual visualisation only. This is not the official engineering design, as-built geometry, station layout, or surveyed model.
plannedOutputs: A 21.26 km elevated viaduct from Uttara North to Kamalapur, as described in the RTHD report.
Mass-transit facilities intended to improve effective, efficient, safe and environment-friendly transport in Dhaka.

outcomes.intended: Introduce efficient public mass transit for Dhaka City, with safe and environment-friendly transport.
outcomes.measured: The February 2026 report records construction progress and expenditure. It does not, in this report, quantify passenger outcomes, journey-time savings, emissions reduction or safety outcomes.

approval.sourceTitle: RTHD — Dhaka Mass Rapid Transit Development Project (Line-6), progress up to February 2026
approval.sourcePage: Printed pages 1–4; approval/revision table on page 2

progress.currentness: Older snapshot; newer October 2026 RTHD report is indexed but not yet transcribed.

progress.label: Motijheel to Kamalapur extension

progress.currentness: Older snapshot; newer October 2026 RTHD report is indexed but not yet transcribed.

progress.label: Expenditure against the 3rd revised allocation
progress.scope: Financial progress reported by RTHD against the third revised allocation; not physical completion.
progress.currentness: Older snapshot; newer October 2026 RTHD report is indexed but not yet transcribed.

annualFinance.periodNote: Reported only up to February 2026; not a full-year actual.

projects.cumulativeNote: Arithmetic sum of the annual reported expenditure rows above, including the partial FY2025-26 figure through February 2026. The annual figures retain the original report's units and period labels.
dataLimitations: No surveyed project route geometry has been imported; only the official district/corridor description is shown on the map.
Physical and financial progress percentages are separate and dated 28 February 2026.
